page.layout: One page of text, centred title block; below it a framed woodcut vignette with an arched inscription; the imprint below the vignette. Handwritten annotations (library ink) in the left and right margin areas are not printed text and are left out.

main_text.l: Hel. Bernatis, in Acad. Lauf. Phil. Prof.
referuntur præcipua, quæ circa veterum Hebræorum
dogmata, ritus & statuta, in utroque Talmude,
Cum INDICIBVS in V. & N. TESTAMENTVM,

page.notes: Handwritten ink annotations ("Bibl.", "Coll. Rom. 21") in the margins are library marks and were omitted. The vignette banner reads "GRADATIM AD SIDERA TOLLOR" along the arch; the last letters are uncertain and transcribed as printed in the scan. The 'Ioh.' abbreviation and 'Phil.' are as printed.
